hooks.command: jq -r '[.cwd, (.last_assistant_message // "")] | @tsv' | { IFS=$'\t' read -r cwd msg; dir=$(basename "$cwd"); snippet=$(echo "$msg" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-100); notify-send -u normal -i dialog-information -t 20000 "Claude Code — dokončené — $dir" "$snippet" 2>/dev/null; paplay --volume=65536 /usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/window-attention.oga 2>/dev/null || canberra-gtk-play -i complete 2>/dev/null; } || true

jq -r '[.cwd, (.message // "")] | @tsv' | { IFS=$'\t' read -r cwd msg; dir=$(basename "$cwd"); snippet=$(echo "$msg" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-100); idf="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}/claude-code-waiting-notif-id"; old=$(cat "$idf" 2>/dev/null); case "$old" in ""|*[!0-9]*) set -- ;; *) set -- -r "$old" ;; esac; new=$(notify-send -p "$@" -u normal -i dialog-question -t 20000 "Claude Code — čaká na vstup — $dir" "$snippet" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$new" ] && printf "%s" "$new" > "$idf"; paplay --volume=39321 /usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga 2>/dev/null || canberra-gtk-play -i complete 2>/dev/null; } || true
